title: Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key DX
alternative_titles: ライザのアトリエ３ ～終わりの錬金術士と秘密の鍵～ DX
description: Ryza and her friends return for a final summer adventure exploring the origins of alchemy and the mysteries of their world. This DX edition adds playable characters Clifford, Serri, and Kilo, a new story, custom combat settings, usability improvements, and the original game’s additional content.

player_sentiment.summary: In one sampled discussion about Ryza 3 DX, players welcome clearer Switch 2 visuals and convenient portable play, while some criticize PC optimization and remaining small interface text. Experiences vary by platform and hardware; these launch-era observations are not a representative consensus or a current technical assessment.
positives: Clearer visuals on Switch 2 compared with the original Switch release
Convenient portable play and suspend functionality
negatives: PC performance concerns reported by some players
Small interface and party-chatter text despite subtitle-size options
